no-chat-restrictions:
This mod is dedicated to the removal of restrictions around the use of multiplayer features, in particular the in-game chat. It unblocks chat and other features that may otherwise be impossible to use with your Minecraft account.

As of  1.16.4 , along with the introduction of Social Interactions screen, vanilla Minecraft client may now prevent access to multiplayer menu or in-game chat based on Minecraft account flags, which are controlled by  Mojang/Microsoft  and may be enabled or disabled for any reason. This mod simply reverts that change, letting all multiplayer features be accessed exactly like they could be in  1.16.3  and prior.

These restrictions are enforced only on the client side, and as such this mod needs to be installed only on the client in order for it to work (though this might change in future Minecraft versions).

This 模组 contains shared code that are used across multiple 模组, as well as some platform helpers, to make Porting and Multiple 模组 Loader support easier during development. This 模组 does not do anything on its own, and requires a "Module" (or 模组 that relies on this library) to perform any work. Other developers are welcome to use this library for their own projects, but keep in mind that it's primarily designed for our usage, and does not always contain all the features that other library 模组 contain. When things go wrong, and they definitely do from time to time, you can open an Issue on Github if it's a bug or suggestion, or for quicker support, you can join our discord and ask your question in the appropriate channel

Modular Force Field System (or MFFS) is a mod that adds force fields, high tech machinery and defensive measures to Minecraft. Ever tired of nuclear explosions blowing up your house or want to keep people out of your secret bases? May the force (fields) be with you!

 Usage

MFFS uses Fortron as its main power source for force fields. It contains a series of machines focused on converting energy to Forton for the use in generating force fields.
The primary machine is the Force Field Projector which is powered by Fortron Capacitors (storage) and Coercion Derivers (generators).
The projector can be modified with various cards and upgrades that improve its stats. These upgrades include several field shapes, size scaling, position offset, and utility modules. For example, the upgrade to shock attacks, kill monsters, remove blocks, and protect tiles.

one-click-join:
One Click Join is a Minecraft mod that allows you to join your last Minecraft server through a button on the main menu!

The last minecraft server that you join will be remembered, and when you return to the main menu or restart your game, a button will appear beside the multiplayer button, allowing you to re-join that server in one click.

 Servers joined via the 'Direct Connect' feature, or by another mod connecting you to a server, will not be recognized by One Click Join. 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 Have any issues or suggestions?

If you're having issues with One Click Join, or you'd like to make a suggestion, you can do so over on the GitHub issues page.

Mekanism Covers

 

A Mekanism addon that adds a simple way to cover its cables and pipes.

 Showcase

 

 

 How to use

Craft the cover and combine it with the desired block in the crafting table. After that just right click the cable or pipe you want to cover.

If you want to remove the cover, just break the block, use a Configurator in the wrench mode, or a wrench of another tech mod.

 Crashing with Iris, Oculus, Sodium, Embeddium, etc?

If you're having any crashes while using mods that change Minecraft's rendering. Go into the config file located at your .minecraft/config/mekanismcovers.json, and set disableAdvancedCoverRendering to true.

 

 Recipes

 
 
 

 Other information

For bug reporting please proceed to the mod's GitHub repository: https://github.com/lucaargolo/mekanism-covers

If you have any other questions or suggestions, feel free to call me on Discord @D4rk 0693

Clavis transforms the traditional loot system: every loot chest is now locked and can be opened through a simple yet engaging mini-game. The better you perform, the richer your reward - up to nearly double the loot for a perfect result.

 

 Lock's difficulty depends on how valuable the loot inside is. The richer the loot, the harder the lockpicking mini-game: faster speed, more tasks, and extra rules that change how the game plays. There are 3 main difficulty levels, marked by the color of the smiley in the mini-game interface and the outline color of the lock floating above the chest. This lets you decide in advance whether the chest is worth your time.

Raw Input Buffer 

This mod aims to reduce input lag, micro-stutters, and frame rate drops caused by Minecraft's default mouse handling. This is especially noticiable on polling rates above 1000 Hz, where frame rates can drop by 50-70% when moving the camera around, depending on the polling rate. With this mod installed you'll be able to use polling rates higher than 1000 Hz with no stutters.

My testing was done using a mouse with a polling rate of up to 8000 Hz.

---
 Solution:

This mod intercepts and replaces Minecraft's mouse handling. Instead of relying on GLFW, the mod communicates directly with the Windows Kernal and offloads mouse polling to a dedicated, asynchronous background thread using a hidden window class.
When the cursor is locked in game, standard legacy mouse data is no longer generated, freeing up CPU resources.

unruled-api:
Unruled API

 

Allows to create new form of gamerules, beyond the restrictive vanilla integers and booleans.

This mod enables developers to easily create new floating, long, double, string, text, enum-driven,
entity selector and even registry-entry gamerules, using their respective builders,
all available from the com.nerjal.unruled api.UnruledApi class's static methods.

It also provides means to add value validators alongside registering new gamerules, which in turn
allows to restrict the range of valid values for gamerules. For instance, it can be used to only allow
odd values in an integer gamerule.

Additionally, this mod also adds per-dimension gamerule overrides! These are applied in their
strict dimension (provided they are queried correctly).
See gamerules overrides for more details about it.

 Gamerules registration

Example:
 java
import com.nerjal.unruled api.UnruledApi;

Automatically generates distant terrain LODs (Levels of Detail) for Voxy
without requiring you to fly through every chunk.

Voxy renders your world far beyond the normal render distance, but by default
it can only build that distant view AFTER a player physically visits each chunk.
This mod fixes that: it hooks into server-loaded chunks (including those loaded
by Chunky or any other chunk pregenerator) and generates the LOD data in the
background automatically — no player movement needed.

Works on singleplayer worlds and dedicated servers. On a server, every connected
client benefits from the pregeneration — players see the distant terrain the
moment they join, even for areas they have never visited.

WARNING: EARLY ALPHA — expect bugs. Singleplayer works great. Dedicated server
support is functional but still has known issues — use with caution.

maceoptimiser:
In Minecraft PvP and PvE, lag often causes "Ghost Hits"—situations where your client thinks you hit an enemy, plays the sound and particles, but the server rejects it because you were slightly too far away.
 ​The Solution:
 This Fabric mod acts as a client-side range limiter. It calculates the exact distance to your target before you swing. If the target is further than 3.0 blocks (the standard survival reach), the mod prevents the attack packet from sending.
 ​Features:
- ​Instant Feedback: If you don't swing, you know you need to move closer.
- ​Client-Side Only: Works on any server without needing to be installed on the server.
- ​Lightweight: Zero performance impact.
- ​Fair Play: Does not increase reach; it only validates it to match vanilla behavior.

translater:
Translater takes all the text in minecraft and runs it through Google Translate 5 times (configurable).
This leaves the text in a state that is still partially understandable but hilarious to play with.
The mod caches all responses from Google Translate to reduce loading times as creating the cache can take up to 3 hours for vanilla (~5000 pieces of text)
This allows it to have no major impact on loading/performance after generating the cache.
In fact, a pre-generated name cache is even contained in the mod and will be used if possible.
You can also download the additional file with pre-cached responses for most mods to improve speeds at the cost of a bit more disk space.
Please note that generating the additional file takes some time, so it might not be available right after an update
This should work fine with most other mods that use the vanilla system for translation.

Durability Ping is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod that helps you avoid breaking your tools, weapons, and armor by warning you when their durability is low.

When an item is about to break (default ~10% durability, or your configured threshold), you’ll receive:
- A red warning message 
- A short sound notification 

 Example:

- Monitors durability of:
 - Main hand & off hand items
 - Helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots
- Warns only once per item until it’s repaired or replaced.
- Default warn threshold: ~10% durability left, takes Unbreaking enchantments into account.

 Configuration
- Adjustable warning threshold (default 10%)
- Enable/disable warning sound (default on)
- For in-game configuration via a GUI, ModMenu is required

Advanced Locate

 About

Advanced Locate aims to upgrade the Vanilla locate command by adding new functionalities to it.

 Functionalities

 Searching for multiple structures of the same type at once
 Locating the nearest Slime chunk 
 Locating the point with the highest density of Slime chunks around, useful for big Slime farms 
 
 Usage

 /loc structure nearest (amount) [structure] , amount being, the amount of structure you want to search for, set to 5 by default, and structure being the structure you want to search.

mining-cooldown-fix-forge:
A forge version of Covenant\ Turtle's Mining Cool Down Fix
 

By default, the Minecraft client has a hard-coded delay of (5 ticks) between break a block and starting to break another, unless your total mining speed would allow you insta-mine it, as per the following wiki article: [https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Breaking Instant\ breaking](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Breaking Instant%5C breaking)

This mod simply sets that delay to 0, allowing you to break multiple blocks much faster than before, without affecting the time it takes to break a single block.

However, it is handled this way in vanilla to avoid accidentally mining too many blocks if your mining speed is high enough. This mod also introduces a new enchantment that limits your mining speed to (1 + level) ticks.

no-trade-cooldown:
♾️ NoTradeCooldown 

Removes villager trade cooldowns so you can trade infinitely without waiting. No more locked trades, no more restock timers — every trade is always available. 
How It Works 

In vanilla Minecraft 26.1, villager trades have a maxUses limit. Once you've traded enough times, the offer becomes "out of stock" and is permanently greyed out. The villager then needs to restock before the trade becomes available again. NoTradeCooldown intercepts the increaseUses() method on MerchantOffer and prevents the use counter from incrementing. This means trades never reach their limit and stay available forever.

 Features 

- Infinite trades — every offer stays available after every single trade
- No restock cooldown — villagers never enter a "restocking" state
- Works with data-driven trades — fully compatible with the new 26.1 trade system
- Server-side optional — works on servers

No Lag Tick Rate Changer

This is another Tick Rate Changer mod, that lets you slow down and speed up time to perform epic gameplay blah blah blah…

 

 What means "No Lag"?

In a common Tick Rate Changer, you change the tick per second that Minecraft runs at (by default 20), and because Minecraft check for inputs (like clicking) every tick, the input lag increases. (With 20 tps, 0.05 s of input lag, with 0.5 tps, 2s of input lag :C)

But in this Tick Rate Changer, inputs are checked in another loop independent to the tps, so slowing down doesn't increase input lag.

csgo-box:
核心玩法 ①：CS 箱子（开箱抽奖）

把 CS:GO 那种「开箱 — 揭晓 — 稀有度」的体验原样搬到 Minecraft：

1. 用 /give @p csgobox:csgo box 领一个箱子，配上对应等级的钥匙；
2. 手持箱子右键，看预览、把钥匙塞进卡槽；
3. 点「开启」，一段滚动揭晓动画后，结果停在属于你的战利品上。

- 5 档稀有度 ：consumer / industrial / mil spec / restricted / classified，越稀有越难抽，每档独立权重；
- 4 档钥匙 ：铁、金、钻石、下界合金，最高档只能靠锻造台升级获得；
- 自定义箱子 ：改 config/csbox/ .json 就能加新箱子、调权重，不用重新编译；
- 批量开箱 ：Shift + 右键进入总览屏，一次开一整组，流水揭晓；
- 成就 & 命令 ：首次开箱成就、累计开 200 箱的隐藏挑战，以及 /csbox 查看 / 重载配置。

 核心玩法 ②：终端机（谈判式购买）

终端机是一条独立的「谈判式抽卡」线：用武库点数向军火商买开箱产物，5 轮报价逐轮讨价还价。

- 五轮谈判 ：每轮长按「接受」成交，或长按「拒绝」等下一轮，最多 5 轮；
- 随机磨损 ：有耐久的物品按磨损扣耐久；没耐久的物品磨损折算成加价（每 5% 磨损 +1 武库点数，最多 +20）；
- 服务端权威会话 ：中途关闭再打开，对话、报价和轮次跟上次完全一致；转手给别人的终端机对方无法交易，只会收到「去问问 xx 吧」；
- 3 小时倒计时 ：按世界运行时间计，暂停游戏和关服不计时，重启后续算；
- 一台一次 ：成交、5 轮全拒、超时三种结局都会销毁终端机，用完再弄一台；
- 批量购买 & 3D 检视 ：支持一次批量买（上限可选 30 / 64 / 200 / 400 / 800 / 无上限），报价物品可拖拽 3D 检视。

 经济闭环：开箱 → 点数 → 再买

- 军火商职业村民可以用绿宝石 / 铁锭 / 金锭 / 钻石换武库点数，也卖箱子、钥匙和终端机；
- 用 武库拆解台 把

instaslate:
InstaSlate

A very simple datapack that makes you able to insta-mine Deepslate if you have a Netherite pickaxe with Efficiency V and Haste II.

 How it works

This pack changes the mining speed of Netherite Pickaxes by adding the following rule to the minecraft:tool component of netherite pickaxes in an item modifier:
 
{
 "blocks": "minecraft:deepslate",
 "correct for drops": true,
 "speed": 38.3
}
 
This rule only changes the mining speed of Deepslate. The item modifier only gets applied if your pickaxe has Efficiency V and you have Haste II, and gets removed again if the effect runs out. Therefore, there are no side-effects other than being able to insta-mine deepslate.

 Demo
If you want to see a demonstration of the datapack, check out this video by Derex Tex Archives!
 

 Uninstalling
You can run /function instaslate: /uninstall to remove the datapack. This will also remove the spe

entityculling-1.8.9-port:
EntityCulling (1.8.9 Port)
This mod is the port to 1.8.9 of the original mod EntityCulling , which was made by Meldexun.

The original mod is present at: Modrinth or GitHub

Disclamer: i have permission from Meldexun for publishing this port.

Do not report an issue of this mod to Meldexun. Report it at the provided github "Issues" page.

 About EntityCulling

 EntityCulling is a client-side performance mod that aims to skip rendering of hidden (tile-)entities. In vanilla, it just renders all (tile-)entities that are in the field of view of the player. This means there may be hundreds of (tile-)entities eating your fps while you can't even see them because they are hidden behind a wall.

 Culling of hidden Entities 

By default, this mod uses an OpenGL occlusion culling implementation which gives you pixel-perfect bounding box culling with only one frame delay and a very small overhead.

ping-system:
Adds a simple ping system that allows players to mark mobs, items, blocks, and other players using a ping wheel. Simply hover over the ping type you want and release the hotkey. 

Pings are visible in-world and provide a quick way to point out locations or entities without using chat.

The mod includes team support, so pings are only visible to players on the same team (teamless is treated as its own team). This allows coordination without revealing information to others on the server.

Pings are highly configurable. Options include adjusting how long pings last, whether pings follow moving targets such as players or mobs (for pvp balancing), and the size and duration of the ping. When a ping is placed, a corresponding message is also shown in chat to indicate who pinged and what was pinged.

The mod is designed to be flexible and usable in both singleplayer and multiplayer environments.

Integrated Cleanup

Integrated Cleanup is an Ornithe mod for Minecraft versions 1.3 to 1.7 that fixes a bunch of multiplayer bugs to bring the game closer to the intended singleplayer experience.

Integrated Cleanup can be used on clients as well as servers: vanilla players will still be able to connect, but players with the mod will experience the full set of fixes in your server. Likewise, players with the mod can still play on vanilla server just fine, albeit with client-side tweaks only.

 List of Fixes

Legend:
- (C) Effective on all servers for clients with the mod installed client-side
- (I) Effective on integrated servers only
- (S) Effective only on the integrated server or servers that have the mod installed
- (V) Effective for all clients with the mod installed server-side

Fixes:
- (C) Entities no longer have jittery movement
- (C) Entities turn their heads smoothly with quad

vanilla-graves:
Losing hours of progress to a surprise creeper or a long fall is frustrating—but "tombstone" mods often feel out of place in a blocky world. Vanilla Graves offers a lightweight, lore-friendly solution that uses Minecraft's existing mechanics to protect your hard-earned gear.

 Key Features 

 Automatic Chest Placement: Upon death, the mod checks your inventory. If you are carrying items, it instantly places a chest (or a double chest) at your feet to store everything safely.
 
 Death Coordinates: No more guessing where you fell. The moment you respawn, a private message appears in your chat with the exact X, Y, and Z coordinates of your grave.
 
 Lava Protection: The mod attempts to find the safest nearby spot to place the chest, preventing your items from burning away instantly.
 
 Minimalist & Lightweight: No new blocks, no complex GUI, and no "magic" items. It feels like a feature Moj

sapience:
Vanilla villagers do not give you much to know. They work, sleep, stare at a wall for a while, and go "hrmm." I made Sapience because I wanted the same villagers to feel like they had an actual life behind their face.

Every villager gets a name, a personality, moods, needs, relationships, and a memory of things that really happened. Feed somebody when they are hungry and they remember who helped. Hurt them and that sticks too. If another villager saw it, the story may travel.

What matters to me is that their behavior has a reason. They do not roll behavioral dice just to create drama. Their choices come from what they know, what they need, how they feel, and who they are dealing with. Spend enough time around one villager and you can start to understand them.

One evening during testing, I watched a villager cross the square, stand beside a grieving neighbor, and stay there for a while

Lost Loot

 Description

A fun mod to spice up a server. Fish up or brush up despawned loot! When loot despawns, it is added to a pool of items. Only 10 of each item type (configurable) can exist in this pool. When doing archeology or fishing, there is a chance (configurable) to find this despawned loot. It will display the date it was dropped and by who it was dropped if it was dropped by a player.

 Configuring

config/PandaArchaeology.json generated at runtime

 
{
 "activeForFishing": true, //Whether to activate for fishing
 "activeForBrushing": true, //Whether to activate for brushing
 "onlyPlayerOwned": false, //Only player dropped items will be added 
 "itemLimit": 10, //The max amount of any item type (set 0 to disable)
 "fishingChance": 60, //The 1 in x chance to find a despawned item when fishing 
 "brushChance": 10 //The 1 in x chance to find a despawned item when brushing 
 "

📘 SleepPoll — Fabric Mod (Minecraft 1.21.11)
 A lightweight, server-side voting system for skipping the night in multiplayer. 

---

 Description
 SleepPoll is a server-side Fabric mod that replaces vanilla night skipping with a fair voting system .

When a player enters a bed, the mod automatically creates a poll. 
All online players can vote YES or NO using clickable chat buttons.

The night is skipped only if the combined support of:
- Sleeping players 
- Players who vote YES
- AFK Players / Players that didn't vote will automatically vote yes at the end of the poll 

meets or exceeds the percentage defined by the playersSleepingPercentage gamerule .

SleepPoll also prevents vanilla from skipping the night prematurely and uses a smooth 10-second transition instead.

Perfect for multiplayer servers that want fairness and community-driven control over the night cycle.

---

 Features

📘 SleepPoll -Fabric 模组（《我的世界》1.21.11） 一个轻量级的服务器端投票系统，用于在多人游戏中跳过夜晚。 --- 描述 SleepPoll是一个服务器端的Fabric 模组，它用一个公平的投票系统取代了普通的夜间跳跃。 当一个玩家进入一张床时，模组会自动创建一个投票。 所有在线玩家都可以使用可点击的聊天按钮投票赞成或反对。 仅当以下各项的组合支持时，才会跳过该夜晚： - 正在睡觉的玩家 - 投赞成票的玩家 - AFK玩家/未投票的玩家将在投票结束时自动投赞成票 达到或超过玩家睡眠百分比游戏规则定义的百分比。 SleepPoll还可以防止原版过早地跳过夜晚，并使用平滑的10秒过渡来代替。 非常适合需要公平和社区驱动的夜间控制的多人服务器。 --- 特征

🛠️ QuickEquip

 Never stop mining again. 
 When your pickaxe breaks, QuickEquip instantly finds the best replacement from your inventory — no clicks, no delays. 

---

 🧩 What It Does

QuickEquip is a small Minecraft Forge mod that helps you keep moving. When one of your tools breaks (like a pickaxe or axe), this mod automatically finds a similar tool in your inventory and puts it in your hand.

It chooses the best tool based on:

 🔼 Tool Tier (Netherite Diamond Iron Stone Wood)
 💎 Enchantments (like Efficiency or Unbreaking)
 💚 Durability Left 

You don’t have to pause or open your inventory. It just works.

---

 🎮 How to Use

 ✅ Install the mod like any other Forge mod
 🧱 Put backup tools of the same type in your inventory
 🔨 Break your current tool... and watch it get auto-replaced!
 🔁 Press R to toggle the feature ON or OFF anytime

goety-client-fix:
Goety Client Fix
Fixes client-side memory leaks caused by Goety mods for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge).

Problem
When a player dies/respawns or changes dimension, the old LocalPlayer and ClientLevel objects are not garbage collected. This causes client memory to grow continuously, eventually leading to lag and crashes.

Fixes
Invalidates old player and level capabilities on respawn/dimension change to break reference chains
Clears Mob.target and LivingEntity.lastHurtByMob references to the old player in the client level
Clears static Entity/Player/Level fields in Goety/GoetyAwaken client event handlers via reflection
Periodic cleanup (every 30s) to catch any lingering references
Requirements
Forge 47+ (Minecraft 1.20.1)
Client-side only, server does not need this mod

FFExhaustion

Sprint, fight, and jump all you like... just don't expect to keep it up forever! FFExhaustion adds a fatigue meter that fills as you push yourself and drains while you catch your breath.

 

 How it works

Hard physical work tires you out:

- Sprinting and fast swimming
- Jumping, especially sprint-jumping
- Landing after a long fall
- Swinging your weapon (hits and misses both count)
- Holding up your shield

Take it easy for a moment and you'll start to recover. Standing still or sneaking speeds that up.

As you get tired, you'll notice it: you move more slowly, sprint-jumps don't carry you as far, and your attacks come out more slowly. A HUD icon shows how worn out you are at a glance.

Command Escape

A simple Fabric mod that allows you to escape commands in chat using a backslash. It can also be used with other things.

 Usage

Simply prefix any command with a backslash to send it as regular text:
- \/help → sends "/help" in chat instead of running the command
- \/tp @p 0 100 0 → sends "/tp @p 0 100 0" as a message
- \/gamemode creative → sends "/gamemode creative" as text

Resource Reload Guard

Resource Reload Guard is a client-side mod for Minecraft Java Edition.

Reloading client resources can take several minutes in large modpacks and may cause long garbage-collection pauses, hangs, or crashes. This mod does not make resource loading faster. Instead, it guards known user actions so an expensive reload does not begin accidentally or unnecessarily.

 Supported environments

Resource Reload Guard is client-side only and is available for:

- Fabric (Fabric API required)
- Forge
- NeoForge

 Features

 Resource packs

- Detects enabled, disabled, and reordered packs.
- Skips applying a selection when the pack IDs and order are unchanged.
- Lets you return to editing without losing the current selection.
- Can discard the selection and restore the state from before the screen was opened.
- Can apply now or save the selection for the next launch.

 Language

Credits

 \- Design help: IkBlox 

 The Leveling

Your equipment should feel earned, not disposable. The Leveling gives every eligible weapon and armor piece its own persistent XP, level, and history, allowing the gear you actually use to grow alongside you.

 Level Equipment Through Play

- Weapons earn item XP only when they kill a creature. Damage dealt and repeated hits do not award XP.
- Equipped armor earns XP when you take damage, including damage reduced by enchantments or Resistance.
- Every item progresses independently and begins at level 0.
- The default curve supports 500 levels and can be changed by the server owner.
- Creative-mode progression and PvP rewards are separately configurable.

Player Stats

Player Stats is a server-side Fabric mod that tracks detailed per-player statistics and stores them in per-player JSON files. It works by polling each player's vanilla statistic map on a configurable interval and recording only what changed since the last poll, which keeps server overhead near zero. The collected data is exposed in game through admin commands with formatted, color-coded output. Nothing needs to be installed on the client; players join with a vanilla client and are tracked automatically.

 How it works

- On every poll interval the mod snapshots each online player's vanilla stats, computes the difference against the previous snapshot, and adds the deltas to that player's persistent profile.
- Profiles are saved to stats/player data/ .json in the server folder on a configurable save interval, when a player disconnects, and when the server stops.

Tepuis
A tepui is a table-top mountain or mesa found in South America, especially in Venezuela and western Guyana. The word tepui means "house of the gods" in the native tongue of the Pemon, the indigenous people who inhabit the Gran Sabana.
Tepuis tend to be found as isolated entities rather than in connected ranges, which makes them the host of a unique array of endemic plant and animal species. They are typically composed of sheer blocks of Precambrian quartz arenite sandstone that rise abruptly from the jungle and can be the source the world's tallest waterfalls.
Because of their great age, some tepuis exhibit surface features and caves typical of karst topography, formed in more water-soluble rocks such as limestone. Some of the mesas are pocked with giant sinkholes up to 300 meters (1,000 ft) in diameter and with sheer walls up to 300 meters (1,000 ft) deep.

waves:
Showcase
 

To see more previews, check out the gallery

 Description
This is a texture pack (not a mod or shaderpack) that works in Vanilla Minecraft. To use, all you need to do is apply the pack. No other required installs and no required settings tweaks. There are optional settings that you can access in the texture pack itself or with an optional mod called respackopts.

The waves in the texture pack are extremely simple, and is done by calculating a sine wave for the x direction and a cosine wave for the z direction (both based on height, speed and frequency) then just taking the average of the two. The waves are not meant to be realistic, and instead are meant to add more depth to the base game.

 How to Use

WenKai Screen Font Pack — Enhance Your Gaming Text with Elegance

The WenKai Screen Font Pack is a specialized font collection designed to improve the readability and visual comfort of in-game text. Derived from the original Xiaowu Wenkai (霞鹜文楷) font, WenKai Screen is tailored specifically for display on PC and Android screens. The standard weight of the original Xiaowu Wenkai Regular was found to be too thin for optimal display on PC and Android devices; therefore, the WenKai Screen Font Pack adapts the bolder attributes of the Xiaowu Wenkai Bold variant to the Regular weight, while adjusting the metrics to match those of the default Android font, Roboto. This makes it particularly well-suited for use on both PC and Android mobile device screens.

Inspired by the style often seen in Japanese textbooks, WenKai Screen combines elements of traditional Chinese Song (宋体) and Kai (楷体) styles.

splash-factorial-math:
16 + 1 + 4 is not 21!
One of the splash texts says "Java 16 + 1 + 4 = 21!" and this is incorrect. Clearly, there is not a single person at Mojang who can understand math, if Mojang thinks that 21 factorial is only 5 more than 16. This resource pack fixes this gamebreaking bug to make Minecraft playable again by changing the splash text to "Java 16 + 51,090,942,171,709,439,980 + 4 = 21!"

 16 + 1 is not 17!, either!
From 1.18 to 1.20.4, Minecraft was running on Java 17. As such, the incorrect splash text previously read "Java 16 + 1 = 17!", which is also wrong. Never fear, this resource pack has support for all affected versions, and as such, versions below 1.20.5 change the splash to "Java 16 + 355,687,428,095,984 = 17!"

 Why is this fix necessary?
It should be obvious.

crt-monochrome-shaderpack:
CRT Monochrome Shaderpack

 "End of Line." 

 CRT Monochrome Shaderpack is a lightweight GLSL shader pack for Minecraft Java Edition (Iris/OptiFine) that replicates the high-contrast, phosphor-display aesthetic of early 80s computing.

It replaces standard rendering with a strict two-tone wireframe/threshold visualization, simulating a monochromatic CRT monitor inside the game.

 🖥️ Visual Style

 The "P1" Phosphor Aesthetic
By default, the pack utilizes the "P1 Apple Green" ( 33FF33) color scheme, mimicking the high-persistence green phosphor monitors of the Apple II era. The world is rendered as a stark contrast between illuminated geometry and a pure black void.

 CRT Emulation
The pack includes a fully procedural CRT post-processing stack:
- Screen Curvature: subtle geometric distortion to mimic a curved glass tube.

pam:
PathMax

A voxel path traced shaderpack for Iris.

 

PathMax lights the world by tracing rays through a voxel copy of it that is rebuilt every frame. A torch lights the room from the direction it actually sits in and casts a real shadow. Colour bleeds off the block it bounced from. A lava lake lights the ceiling above it, and nothing in the Nether is lit by a sun, because there isn't one.

Reflections are screen-space, so what you see in water is the finished frame — global illumination, emission, fog and all — rather than a simplified copy of the world re-lit by an approximation.

 What's in it

 Lighting 

 Path traced global illumination, denoised in screen space
 Block lights sampled straight out of the voxel grid with a shadow ray each, so two lamps in one room are two lamps and not one average
 Sun visibility read from the shadow map at every bounce — finer than the grid and eight

cinderframe:
a stylistic found-footage shader for Minecraft.

the idea is simple: the world renders properly, and the camera pointed at it does not. the lighting, shadows and materials underneath are a full modern shader stack. everything sitting on top of that is a cheap camcorder with a dirty lens, running film that has been in the bag too long. grain, a coarse PS1-era dither, a slight handheld weave, warm bleed around bright things, dust on the gate, and a desaturated grade with purple in the shadows.

the point is that it should read as a recording of the world rather than as the world. it is not a horror overlay. there is no permanent HUD, no scanlines, no fake VHS bar wiping down the screen. the world stays legible and you stay able to play; it just looks like somebody else filmed it.

CommandGUI is a Minecraft Spigot plugin that provides players with a custom GUI to execute commands as the player interacting with the GUI. The GUI is fully configurable, allowing you to define items, commands, and layout. Players can also receive a custom item that opens the GUI when used.

---

 Features 
- Custom GUI : A player-friendly interface to execute commands with a click.
- Configurable Items : Define items, their appearance, and the commands they execute in the GUI via the configuration file.
- Dynamic Inventory Sizing : Automatically adjusts the GUI size based on the number of items.
- Customisable Tool : Players can use a custom tool to open the GUI.
- Command Reload : Easily reload the plugin's configuration with /commandgui reload .

---

 Commands 
 /commandgui 
- Description: Opens the Command GUI for the player.
- Aliases: /cg 

 /command
